Local lazy-loaded OCR dependencies: Tesseract.js 6.0.1 (Apache-2.0), Tesseract.js Core 6.1.2 (Apache-2.0), Mozilla PDF.js 4.10.38 (Apache-2.0). Language files come from the 4.0.0_best_int directory of @tesseract.js-data/{eng,hin,tel,tam} 1.0.0, based on Tesseract traineddata (Apache-2.0). License and bundled notices are in this directory. Only LSTM recognition is enabled. Assets are fetched from the same origin as the app.
